tools.description: AgentStack MCP = Work Graph control plane. After session + context.project_id: agents.work_next (mcp_work_loop_v1) -> plan_claim -> plan_execute (CAS/leases). Follow packet.next_action; catalog/discovery.search only if no packet. One-shot CRM/upload may call domain actions directly. Spine: agents.pl

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "agentstack.execute" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prompt:agentstack_read_bootstrap" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read-only MCP bootstrap with continueOnError; omit apikeys.list without api_keys cap

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "agentstack.execute" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Mandatory session order: authenticate -> session probe auth.get_profile (alias auth.me) -> select/create project -> set context.project_id on every batch -> domain work. Playbook GET /mcp/prompts/get?name=agentstack_session_setup (recipe mcp_session_setup). Execute AgentStack operations as steps: id" → after: "AgentStack MCP = Work Graph control plane. After session + context.project_id: agents.work_next (mcp_work_loop_v1) -> plan_claim -> plan_execute (CAS/leases). Follow packet.next_action; catalog/discovery.search only if no packet. One-shot CRM/upload may call domain actions directly. Spine: agents.pl"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
